notes.title: New playtest version is live! Have you missed the Majesty advisor's voice?
notes.content:
We’re very excited to announce a new playtest version, that is now live! Thanks to your feedback and suggestions, we improved various aspects of the game. 

We also have been working with the voice actor from the original Majesty series, and you can now hear his voice in the game! :)

Here’s what’s new:
- A new economic system.
- Threat mechanics. Requires you to destroy monster lairs to reduce the threat level and reduce the waves of attacking enemies.
- You can direct your attention to various manufactures and heroes to temporarily increase their effectiveness.
- New models of buildings and their construction animations.
- Deep reworking of the combat system. Battles have become more exciting and interesting.
- Heroes' equipment is improved by purchasing new items in the store.
- Strongly improved teamwork between heroes in squads.
